question: Muthuswami Dikshitar was a great eminent singer, composer and poet of which music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carnatic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Muthuswami Dikshitar was one of the most renowned composers in the Carnatic music tradition of South India.
 
• He is considered part of the "Trinity of Carnatic Music," alongside Thyagaraja and Syama Sastri, who collectively shaped classical Carnatic music.
 
• Dikshitar composed over 400 songs in Sanskrit, focusing on intricate ragas and talas with devotional themes dedicated to Hindu deities.
